modules.title: Local algebras of a system with a finite configuration space at each site
modules.doc:
The algebra of operators of a finite region is the algebra of matrices on the configurations of
its sites, and a larger region contains it through `M ↦ M ⊗ 1`.

## i. Overview

Every site `s` of a system carries a finite set `Ω s`: the basis states of its local Hilbert
space, such as the two `σ^z` values of a spin, the occupation numbers of a fermion mode, or the
orbitals of an atom. A configuration of a finite region `X` assigns a value to each of its sites,
and the Hilbert space of the region is spanned by these configurations. This is the tensor
product of the local spaces. The operators of the region are the complex matrices indexed by its
configurations, a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, and the operators of a larger region `Y ⊇ X`
contain them as `M ↦ M ⊗ 1`: `M` acts on the sites of `X` and the identity on the others.
This is an injective unital `*`-homomorphism, compatible with composition.

The sites may be the sites of an infinite crystal, and the regions are its finite subsets, so
that the quasi-local algebra of the infinite system is the limit of the local ones. Only finite
site spaces are used.

## ii. Key results

- `Cfg` : the configurations of a region.
- `Alg` : the algebra of operators of a region.
- `inclStarAlg` : the inclusion `M ↦ M ⊗ 1` as a unital `*`-homomorphism.
- `inclMat_trans`, `inclMat_refl` : functoriality of the inclusions.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Configurations of a region and gluing
- B. The operator `M ⊗ 1`

## iv. References

* O. Bratteli & D. Robinson, Operator Algebras and Quantum Statistical Mechanics 2,
  Section 6.1.

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Cfg
declarations.doc:
The configurations of a region: a value of the local configuration space at each of its
sites.
declarations.statement: abbrev Cfg (X : Finset S) : Type _

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.restr
declarations.doc: The restriction of a configuration of a region to a subregion.
declarations.statement: abbrev restr {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) : Cfg Ω X

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Agree
declarations.doc: Two configurations of a region agree outside a subregion.
declarations.statement: def Agree {X Y : Finset S} (_h : X ≤ Y) (c c' : Cfg Ω Y) : Prop
instance {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c c' : Cfg Ω Y) : Decidable (Agree h c c')

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.glue
declarations.doc: Replace the values of `c` inside the subregion `X` by those of `a`.
declarations.statement: def glue {X Y : Finset S} (_h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) (a : Cfg Ω X) : Cfg Ω Y

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.restr_glue
declarations.statement:
lemma restr_glue {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) (a : Cfg Ω X) :

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_glue
declarations.statement:
lemma agree_glue {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) (a : Cfg Ω X) :
    Agree h c (glue h c a)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_iff_glue
declarations.statement:
lemma agree_iff_glue {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) {c c' : Cfg Ω Y} :
    Agree h c c' ↔ glue h c (restr h c') = c'

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_refl
declarations.statement: lemma agree_refl {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (c : Cfg Ω Y) : Agree h c c

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Agree.symm
declarations.statement:
lemma Agree.symm {X Y : Finset S} {h : X ≤ Y} {c c' : Cfg Ω Y} (hc : Agree h c c') :
    Agree h c' c

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Agree.trans
declarations.statement:
lemma Agree.trans {X Y : Finset S} {h : X ≤ Y} {c c' c'' : Cfg Ω Y} (hc : Agree h c c')
    (hc' : Agree h c' c'') : Agree h c c''

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.eq_of_agree_of_restr_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_of_agree_of_restr_eq {X Y : Finset S} {h : X ≤ Y} {c c' : Cfg Ω Y} (hc : Agree h c c')
    (hr : restr h c = restr h c') : c = c'

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.Alg
declarations.doc: The operators on the sites of a region: matrices indexed by configurations.
declarations.statement: abbrev Alg (X : Finset S) : Type _

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat
declarations.doc:
The operator `M ⊗ 1` on a larger region: `M` on the sites of `X` and the identity on the other
sites.
declarations.statement: def inclMat {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M : Alg Ω X) : Alg Ω Y

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma inclMat_apply {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M : Alg Ω X) (c c' : Cfg Ω Y) :
    inclMat h M c c' = if Agree h c c' then M (restr h c) (restr h c') else 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_one
declarations.statement: lemma inclMat_one {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) : inclMat h (1 : Alg Ω X) = 1

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_add
declarations.statement:
lemma inclMat_add {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M N : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (M + N) = inclMat h M + inclMat h N

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma inclMat_smul {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (r : ℂ) (M : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (r • M) = r • inclMat h M

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_conjTranspose
declarations.statement:
lemma inclMat_conjTranspose {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h Mᴴ = (inclMat h M)ᴴ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma inclMat_mul {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M N : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat h (M * N) = inclMat h M * inclMat h N

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_refl
declarations.statement: lemma inclMat_refl {X : Finset S} (M : Alg Ω X) : inclMat (le_refl X) M = M

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_trans_iff
declarations.statement:
lemma agree_trans_iff {X Y Z : Finset S} (h₁ : X ≤ Y) (h₂ : Y ≤ Z) (c c' : Cfg Ω Z) :
    Agree (h₁.trans h₂) c c' ↔ Agree h₂ c c' ∧ Agree h₁ (restr h₂ c) (restr h₂ c')

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclMat_trans
declarations.statement:
lemma inclMat_trans {X Y Z : Finset S} (h₁ : X ≤ Y) (h₂ : Y ≤ Z) (M : Alg Ω X) :
    inclMat (h₁.trans h₂) M = inclMat h₂ (inclMat h₁ M)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.inclStarAlg
declarations.doc: The operator `M ⊗ 1` as a unital `*`-homomorphism.
declarations.statement: def inclStarAlg {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) : Alg Ω X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Alg Ω Y

modules.title: Symmetries of the quantum net
modules.doc:
A group acting on the sites acts on the operators of regions by `*`-isomorphisms, compatibly with
the inclusions.

## i. Overview

Let a group `Γ` act on the sites, all of which carry the same finite configuration space `Ω₀`. The
group moves a region `X` to `γ • X`, and a configuration of `γ • X` to one of `X` by reading the
value at `γ • x` for `x ∈ X`. This moves an operator of `X` to an operator of `γ • X`: it is a
`*`-isomorphism `A X → A (γ • X)`. It is compatible with the inclusion of regions, because it moves
the sites outside `X` to the sites outside `γ • X`.

## ii. Key results

- `cfgEquiv` : a configuration of `γ • X` is a configuration of `X`.
- `quantumIso` : the `*`-homomorphism of operators carried by `γ`.
- `quantumIso_incl` : naturality with respect to the inclusions of regions.
- `symAction` : the group acts on the quasi-local algebra by `*`-automorphisms.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Configurations of a moved region
- B. The moved operators
- C. The action on the quasi-local algebra

## iv. References

* None.

## C. The action on the quasi-local algebra

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.cfgEquiv
declarations.doc: A configuration of the region `γ • X` is a configuration of `X`: read it at `γ • x`.
declarations.statement: def cfgEquiv (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) (γ • X) ≃ Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso
declarations.doc: The operator of `γ • X` that acts as `M` after moving the configurations back to `X`.
declarations.statement:
def quantumIso (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) :
    Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) (γ • X)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.smul_mono
declarations.statement: lemma smul_mono (γ : Γ) {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) : γ • X ≤ γ • Y

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.restr_cfgEquiv
declarations.statement:
lemma restr_cfgEquiv (γ : Γ) {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y)
    (c : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) (γ • Y)) :
    restr h (cfgEquiv Γ Ω₀ γ Y c) = cfgEquiv Γ Ω₀ γ X (restr (smul_mono γ h) c)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.agree_cfgEquiv
declarations.statement:
lemma agree_cfgEquiv (γ : Γ) {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y)
    (c c' : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) (γ • Y)) :
    Agree h (cfgEquiv Γ Ω₀ γ Y c) (cfgEquiv Γ Ω₀ γ Y c') ↔ Agree (smul_mono γ h) c c'

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_incl
declarations.doc: **Naturality**: moving operators commutes with extending them by the identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma quantumIso_incl (γ : Γ) {X Y : Finset S} (h : X ≤ Y) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    quantumIso γ Y (inclMat h M) = inclMat (smul_mono γ h) (quantumIso γ X M)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.cfgCast
declarations.doc: Transport of configurations along an equality of regions.
declarations.statement:
def cfgCast {X Y : Finset S} (e : X = Y) (c : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) Y) :
    Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.regionIso
declarations.doc: Transport of operators along an equality of regions.
declarations.statement:
def regionIso {X Y : Finset S} (e : X = Y) :
    Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X →⋆ₐ[ℂ] Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) Y

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.regionIso_apply
declarations.statement:
lemma regionIso_apply {X Y : Finset S} (e : X = Y) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X)
    (c c' : Cfg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) Y) :
    regionIso e M c c' = M (cfgCast e c) (cfgCast e c')

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.uniformNet
declarations.doc: The quantum net of a system whose sites all carry the same finite configuration space.
declarations.statement: abbrev uniformNet (Ω₀ : Type*) [Fintype Ω₀] [DecidableEq Ω₀] : AlgebraNet S

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.of_regionIso
declarations.statement:
lemma of_regionIso {X Y : Finset S} (e : X = Y) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    (uniformNet Ω₀).of Y (regionIso e M) = (uniformNet Ω₀).of X M

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAct
declarations.doc:
**The action of a site symmetry on the quasi-local algebra**: an endomorphism that moves the
observables of a region `X` to those of `γ • X`.
declarations.statement:
def symAct (γ : Γ) :
    (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAct_of
declarations.statement:
lemma symAct_of (γ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    symAct (Ω₀ := Ω₀) γ ((uniformNet Ω₀).of X M) = (uniformNet Ω₀).of (γ • X) (quantumIso γ X M)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_mul
declarations.statement:
lemma quantumIso_mul (γ₁ γ₂ : Γ) (X : Finset S) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    regionIso (mul_smul γ₁ γ₂ X) (quantumIso (γ₁ * γ₂) X M) =
      quantumIso γ₁ (γ₂ • X) (quantumIso γ₂ X M)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.quantumIso_one
declarations.statement:
lemma quantumIso_one (X : Finset S) (M : Alg (fun _ : S => Ω₀) X) :
    regionIso (one_smul Γ X) (quantumIso (1 : Γ) X M) = M

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAct_mul
declarations.doc: The action of site symmetries is multiplicative.
declarations.statement:
lemma symAct_mul (γ₁ γ₂ : Γ) :
    symAct (Ω₀ := Ω₀) (S := S) (γ₁ * γ₂) = (symAct γ₁).comp (symAct γ₂)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAct_one
declarations.statement: lemma symAct_one : symAct (Ω₀ := Ω₀) (S := S) (1 : Γ) = StarAlgHom.id ℂ _

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symEquiv
declarations.doc: **A group acting on the sites acts on the quasi-local algebra by automorphisms.**
declarations.statement:
def symEquiv (γ : Γ) : (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.QuasiLocal.symAction
declarations.doc:
**The symmetry action** of a group on the sites, as a homomorphism to the automorphisms of the
quasi-local algebra.
declarations.statement:
def symAction : Γ →* ((uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    (uniformNet (S := S) Ω₀).Quasilocal)

modules.title: Which observables of the open tight binding cube commute
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The six observables of the cube are the Hamiltonian `H` and the position `X` of each axis
(`cubePairs`). Two of them on different axes commute (`bracket_cubePairs_of_ne`). Here the
converse: `H` and `X` of one axis do not commute, since their bracket has a nonzero expectation in
the maximal current state, and by Robertson's relation the product of their variances is positive
in that state. So two distinct observables of the cube commute if and only if they lie on
different axes.

## ii. Key results

- `bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq_zero_iff` : on one chain, `⁅H, X⁆ = 0` if and only if
  `t = 0` or the chain has a single site, so the hypotheses below cannot be dropped.
- `axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeVectorState_ne_zero` : in the maximal current state, the expectation
  of `⁅H, X⁆` is nonzero on each axis.
- `bracket_cubePairs_pair_ne_zero` : `H` and `X` of one axis do not commute.
- `bracket_cubePairs_eq_zero_iff` : two distinct observables of the cube commute if and only if
  they lie on different axes.
- `variance_mul_variance_cubePairs_pos` : in the maximal current state, `Var H · Var X > 0` on
  each axis.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. One chain: when `H` and `X` commute
- B. The pair of an axis does not commute
- C. Commuting and axes

## iv. References

* H. P. Robertson, *The uncertainty principle*, Phys. Rev. 34 (1929) 163.

sections.text: ## A. One chain: when `H` and `X` commute
## B. The pair of an axis does not commute

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.hopping_eq_zero_of_degenerate
declarations.doc: Without hopping, or with a single site, the hopping operator is zero.
declarations.statement:
lemma hopping_eq_zero_of_degenerate (T : TightBindingChain) (h : T.t = 0 ∨ T.N < 2) :

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
On one chain, the Hamiltonian and the position commute if and only if there is no hopping or
only one site.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq_zero_iff (T : TightBindingChain) :
    ⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆ = 0 ↔ T.t = 0 ∨ T.N < 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeVectorState_ne_zero
declarations.doc:
In the maximal current state of the cube, the expectation of `⁅H, X⁆` is nonzero on each
axis.
declarations.statement:
lemma axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeVectorState_ne_zero (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0)
    (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) (k : Fin 3) :
    Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) k ≠ 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_cubePairs_pair_ne_zero
declarations.doc: The Hamiltonian and the position of one axis of the cube do not commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracket_cubePairs_pair_ne_zero (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) (k : Fin 3) :
    ⁅Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (0, k), Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (1, k)⁆ ≠ 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_mul_variance_cubePairs_pos
declarations.doc:
In the maximal current state of the cube, the variances of `H` and `X` of each axis have a
positive product.
declarations.statement:
lemma variance_mul_variance_cubePairs_pos (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) (k : Fin 3) :
    0 < variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (0, k)) *
      variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (1, k))

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_cubePairs_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc: Two distinct observables of the cube commute if and only if they lie on different axes.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracket_cubePairs_eq_zero_iff (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) {p q : Fin 2 × Fin 3} (h : p ≠ q) :
    ⁅Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz p, Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz q⁆ = 0 ↔ p.2 ≠ q.2

modules.title: The open tight binding cube
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

Three open tight binding chains `Tx`, `Ty`, `Tz` along the axes of a cube give the sites
`(nx, ny, nz)` and the Hilbert space `𝓗[Fin Nx × Fin Ny × Fin Nz]`. Each observable of a chain
acts on its own axis and leaves the other two in place. Observables of different axes commute:
only the Hamiltonian and the position of the same axis fail to commute.

In the maximal current state of the cube, the product of the maximal current states of the three
chains, each axis carries the constant `C` of its own chain. The energy–position uncertainty
relation of an axis is an equality exactly when that axis has `2` or `3` sites, and it is strict
from `4` sites on, on the three axes at once.

The six observables `(H, X)` of the three axes satisfy Robertson's relation `|det Ω| ≤ det Σ` in
every state of the cube. Since different axes commute, `Ω` is block diagonal and `|det Ω|` is the
product of the squared brackets of the three axes. In the maximal current state `Σ` is block
diagonal too, and `det Σ / |det Ω|` is the product of the squares of the three constants
`C`, so the relation is strict from `4 × 4 × 4` on.

## ii. Key results

- `alongX`, `alongY`, `alongZ` : an observable of a chain acting on its axis of the cube.
- `bracket_alongX_alongY`, `bracket_alongX_alongZ`, `bracket_alongY_alongZ` : different axes
  commute.
- `maxCurrentCubeState` : the maximal current state of the cube.
- `uncertaintyRatio_alongX`, `uncertaintyRatio_alongY`, `uncertaintyRatio_alongZ` : each axis
  carries its own `C`.
- `centeredGramDefect_alongX_eq_zero_iff` (and `Y`, `Z`) : saturation on an axis iff it has `2`
  or `3` sites.
- `robertson_schrodinger_cube` : from `4 × 4 × 4` on, strict on the three axes.
- `cubePairs` : the six observables `(H, X)` of the three axes.
- `bracketMatrix_cubePairs` : in every state `Ω` is block diagonal, one block per axis.
- `robertson_det_cube` : Robertson's relation for the six observables, in every state.
- `covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState` : in the maximal current state `Σ` is block diagonal.
- `det_covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState` : `det Σ = (C(x) C(y) C(z))² |det Ω|`.
- `robertson_det_maxCurrentCubeState_strict` : from `4 × 4 × 4` on, `|det Ω| < det Σ`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Observables along the axes
- B. Different axes commute
- C. The maximal current state of the cube
- D. The uncertainty relation along each axis
- E. Robertson's relation for the six observables of the cube
- F. Robertson's relation in the maximal current state of the cube

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.CubeOperators
declarations.doc: The operators on the Hilbert space of the cube.
declarations.statement: abbrev CubeOperators

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.alongX
declarations.doc: An observable of the chain `Tx` acting on the `x` axis of the cube.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev alongX (a : Observable (Tx.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tx.HilbertSpace)) :
    Observable (Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.alongY
declarations.doc: An observable of the chain `Ty` acting on the `y` axis of the cube.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev alongY (b : Observable (Ty.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Ty.HilbertSpace)) :
    Observable (Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.alongZ
declarations.doc: An observable of the chain `Tz` acting on the `z` axis of the cube.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev alongZ (c : Observable (Tz.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tz.HilbertSpace)) :
    Observable (Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_alongX_alongY
declarations.doc: Observables of the `x` and `y` axes commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracket_alongX_alongY (a : Observable (Tx.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tx.HilbertSpace))
    (b : Observable (Ty.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Ty.HilbertSpace)) :
    ⁅Tx.alongX Ty Tz a, Tx.alongY Ty Tz b⁆ = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_alongX_alongZ
declarations.doc: Observables of the `x` and `z` axes commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracket_alongX_alongZ (a : Observable (Tx.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tx.HilbertSpace))
    (c : Observable (Tz.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tz.HilbertSpace)) :
    ⁅Tx.alongX Ty Tz a, Tx.alongZ Ty Tz c⁆ = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_alongY_alongZ
declarations.doc: Observables of the `y` and `z` axes commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracket_alongY_alongZ (b : Observable (Ty.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Ty.HilbertSpace))
    (c : Observable (Tz.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] Tz.HilbertSpace)) :
    ⁅Tx.alongY Ty Tz b, Tx.alongZ Ty Tz c⁆ = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrentCubeState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state of the cube, the product of those of the three chains.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def maxCurrentCubeState : Tx.CubeHilbertSpace Ty Tz

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_maxCurrentCubeState
declarations.statement: lemma norm_maxCurrentCubeState : ‖Tx.maxCurrentCubeState Ty Tz‖ = 1

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrentCubeVectorState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state of the cube as a state on its operators.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev maxCurrentCubeVectorState : 𝓢[ℂ, Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_alongX
declarations.doc: Along `x`, the cube sees the statistics of the chain `Tx`.
declarations.statement:
lemma variance_alongX :
    variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a) =
      variance Tx.maxCurrentVectorState a

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongX
declarations.statement:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongX :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a)
      (Tx.alongX Ty Tz b) = centeredGramDefect Tx.maxCurrentVectorState a b

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_alongY
declarations.doc: Along `y`, the cube sees the statistics of the chain `Ty`.
declarations.statement:
lemma variance_alongY :
    variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b') =
      variance Ty.maxCurrentVectorState b'

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongY
declarations.statement:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongY :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b')
      (Tx.alongY Ty Tz c') = centeredGramDefect Ty.maxCurrentVectorState b' c'

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_alongZ
declarations.doc: Along `z`, the cube sees the statistics of the chain `Tz`.
declarations.statement:
lemma variance_alongZ :
    variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'') =
      variance Tz.maxCurrentVectorState b''

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongZ
declarations.statement:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongZ :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'')
      (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz c'') = centeredGramDefect Tz.maxCurrentVectorState b'' c''

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_alongX
declarations.doc: The `x` axis of the cube carries the constant `C` of the chain `Tx`.
declarations.statement:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_alongX :
    √(variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.openHamiltonianObservable) *
      variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.positionObservable)) /
        |Tx.a * Tx.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Tx.N + 1))| = Tx.uncertaintyRatio

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_alongY
declarations.doc: The `y` axis of the cube carries the constant `C` of the chain `Ty`.
declarations.statement:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_alongY :
    √(variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.openHamiltonianObservable) *
      variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.positionObservable)) /
        |Ty.a * Ty.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Ty.N + 1))| = Ty.uncertaintyRatio

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_alongZ
declarations.doc: The `z` axis of the cube carries the constant `C` of the chain `Tz`.
declarations.statement:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_alongZ :
    √(variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.openHamiltonianObservable) *
      variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.positionObservable)) /
        |Tz.a * Tz.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Tz.N + 1))| = Tz.uncertaintyRatio

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongX_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
Along `x`, the centered Gram defect vanishes, that is the uncertainty relation is an
equality, iff the axis has `2` or `3` sites.
declarations.statement:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongX_eq_zero_iff (ht : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ Tx.N) :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
      (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.positionObservable) = 0 ↔
      Tx.N = 2 ∨ Tx.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongY_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc: Along `y`, the uncertainty relation is an equality iff the axis has `2` or `3` sites.
declarations.statement:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongY_eq_zero_iff (ht : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ Ty.N) :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
      (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.positionObservable) = 0 ↔
      Ty.N = 2 ∨ Ty.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_alongZ_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc: Along `z`, the uncertainty relation is an equality iff the axis has `2` or `3` sites.
declarations.statement:
lemma centeredGramDefect_alongZ_eq_zero_iff (ht : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ Tz.N) :
    centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
      (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.positionObservable) = 0 ↔
      Tz.N = 2 ∨ Tz.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_cube
declarations.doc:
Robertson–Schrödinger on the cube. From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the uncertainty relation of
the maximal current state is strict on the three axes at once: the centered Gram defect of each
axis is positive.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_cube (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N) :
    0 < centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
        (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.positionObservable) ∧
      0 < centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
        (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.positionObservable) ∧
      0 < centeredGramDefect (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
        (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.openHamiltonianObservable) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.positionObservable)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.conjugatePair
declarations.doc: The conjugate pair of a chain: its Hamiltonian and its position.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def conjugatePair (T : TightBindingChain) :
    Fin 2 → Observable (T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cubePairs
declarations.doc:
The six observables of the cube, the conjugate pair `(H, X)` of each axis: `(j, k)` is the
`j`-th member of the pair of the axis `k`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def cubePairs : Fin 2 × Fin 3 → Observable (Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.axisBracket
declarations.doc: The expectation `ω⟨⁅H, X⁆⟩` of the bracket of the pair of the axis `k`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def axisBracket (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz]) (k : Fin 3) : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cubePairs_x
declarations.statement:
lemma cubePairs_x (j : Fin 2) :
    Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (j, 0) = Tx.alongX Ty Tz (Tx.conjugatePair j)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cubePairs_y
declarations.statement:
lemma cubePairs_y (j : Fin 2) :
    Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (j, 1) = Tx.alongY Ty Tz (Ty.conjugatePair j)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cubePairs_z
declarations.statement:
lemma cubePairs_z (j : Fin 2) :
    Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz (j, 2) = Tx.alongZ Ty Tz (Tz.conjugatePair j)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracket_cubePairs_of_ne
declarations.doc: Observables of different axes of the cube commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracket_cubePairs_of_ne {p q : Fin 2 × Fin 3} (h : p.2 ≠ q.2) :
    ⁅Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz p, Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz q⁆ = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bracketMatrix_cubePairs
declarations.doc:
In every state of the cube the bracket matrix `Ω` of the six observables is block diagonal,
one antisymmetric `2 × 2` block per axis.
declarations.statement:
lemma bracketMatrix_cubePairs (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz]) :
    bracketMatrix ω (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz) =
      blockDiagonal fun k => !![0, Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω k; -Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω k, 0]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_det_cube
declarations.doc:
**Robertson's relation on the cube.** In every state of the cube the volume `det Σ` of the
dispersion of the six observables is at least the product of the squared brackets of the three
axes.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_det_cube (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, Tx.CubeOperators Ty Tz]) :
    (Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω 0 * Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω 1 * Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz ω 2) ^ 2 ≤
      (covarianceMatrix ω (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz)).det

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongX
declarations.statement:
lemma covariance_alongX :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz b) =
      covariance Tx.maxCurrentVectorState a b

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongY
declarations.statement:
lemma covariance_alongY :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b') (Tx.alongY Ty Tz c') =
      covariance Ty.maxCurrentVectorState b' c'

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongZ
declarations.statement:
lemma covariance_alongZ :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'') (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz c'') =
      covariance Tz.maxCurrentVectorState b'' c''

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongX_alongY
declarations.doc: In the maximal current state of the cube the `x` and `y` axes are uncorrelated.
declarations.statement:
lemma covariance_alongX_alongY :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b') = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongX_alongZ
declarations.doc: In the maximal current state of the cube the `x` and `z` axes are uncorrelated.
declarations.statement:
lemma covariance_alongX_alongZ :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongX Ty Tz a) (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'') = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_alongY_alongZ
declarations.doc: In the maximal current state of the cube the `y` and `z` axes are uncorrelated.
declarations.statement:
lemma covariance_alongY_alongZ :
    covariance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.alongY Ty Tz b') (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz b'') =
      0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState
declarations.doc:
In the maximal current state of the cube the covariance matrix `Σ` of the six observables is
block diagonal, the block of each axis being the covariance matrix of its chain.
declarations.statement:
lemma covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState :
    covarianceMatrix (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz) =
      blockDiagonal ![covarianceMatrix Tx.maxCurrentVectorState Tx.conjugatePair,
        covarianceMatrix Ty.maxCurrentVectorState Ty.conjugatePair,
        covarianceMatrix Tz.maxCurrentVectorState Tz.conjugatePair]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.det_covarianceMatrix_conjugatePair
declarations.doc:
In the maximal current state of a chain, `det Σ = C² (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))²` for the
pair `(H, X)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma det_covarianceMatrix_conjugatePair (T : TightBindingChain) (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    (covarianceMatrix T.maxCurrentVectorState T.conjugatePair).det =
      T.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2 * (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sq_axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeState
declarations.doc:
In the maximal current state of the cube, the bracket of each axis is that of its chain,
`± a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sq_axisBracket_maxCurrentCubeState :
    (Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 0 *
        Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 1 *
        Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 2) ^ 2 =
      (Tx.a * Tx.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Tx.N + 1)) *
        (Ty.a * Ty.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Ty.N + 1))) *
        (Tz.a * Tz.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (Tz.N + 1)))) ^ 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.det_covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState
declarations.doc:
In the maximal current state of the cube, `det Σ = C(x)² C(y)² C(z)² |det Ω|`:
the ratio of the two sides of Robertson's relation is the product of the constants of the three
axes.
declarations.statement:
lemma det_covarianceMatrix_maxCurrentCubeState (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) :
    (covarianceMatrix (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz)).det =
      (Tx.uncertaintyRatio * Ty.uncertaintyRatio * Tz.uncertaintyRatio) ^ 2 *
        (Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 0 *
          Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 1 *
          Tx.axisBracket Ty Tz (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) 2) ^ 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_det_maxCurrentCubeState_strict
declarations.doc:
**Robertson's relation is strict in the maximal current state of the cube.** From
`4 × 4 × 4` on, `|det Ω| < det Σ` for the six observables of the cube.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_det_maxCurrentCubeState_strict (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0)
    (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N) :
    |(bracketMatrix (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz)).det| <
      (covarianceMatrix (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz) (Tx.cubePairs Ty Tz)).det

modules.title: Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao on the open tight binding cube
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In the maximal current state of the cube, each axis sees only its own chain, so the
Mandelstam–Tamm ratio `⟨J⟩² / (4 Var H · Var X)` of an axis is the ratio `1 / C²` of the maximal
current state of that chain.

## ii. Key results

- `mandelstamTammRatio_alongX` (and `Y`, `Z`) : each axis of the cube has the ratio of its chain.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The Mandelstam–Tamm ratio along each axis

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## A. The Mandelstam–Tamm ratio along each axis

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_alongX
declarations.doc: Along `x`, the maximal current state of the cube has the ratio `1 / C²` of `Tx`.
declarations.statement:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_alongX :
    (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)⟨Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 /
      (4 * (variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.openHamiltonianObservable) *
        variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongX Ty Tz Tx.positionObservable))) = 1 / Tx.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_alongY
declarations.doc: Along `y`, the maximal current state of the cube has the ratio `1 / C²` of `Ty`.
declarations.statement:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_alongY :
    (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)⟨Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 /
      (4 * (variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.openHamiltonianObservable) *
        variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongY Ty Tz Ty.positionObservable))) = 1 / Ty.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_alongZ
declarations.doc: Along `z`, the maximal current state of the cube has the ratio `1 / C²` of `Tz`.
declarations.statement:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_alongZ :
    (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)⟨Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 /
      (4 * (variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.openHamiltonianObservable) *
        variance (Tx.maxCurrentCubeVectorState Ty Tz)
          (Tx.alongZ Ty Tz Tz.positionObservable))) = 1 / Tz.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2

modules.title: The volumetric quantum of the open tight binding cube
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

A cube `Nx × Ny × Nz` carries one constant `C` per axis (`uncertaintyRatio_alongX`,
`uncertaintyRatio_alongY`, `uncertaintyRatio_alongZ`), so its volumetric quantum is the product
`δ(Nx) δ(Ny) δ(Nz)` of the dimensional quanta `δ = C - 1` of its axes: it vanishes iff some axis
has `2` or `3` sites, is positive from `4 × 4 × 4` on, grows strictly in each axis and stays
below `(√(π² / 3 - 2) - 1)³`.

## ii. Key results

- `volQuantum` : the volumetric quantum `δ(Nx) δ(Ny) δ(Nz)` of the cube.
- `volQuantum_eq_zero_iff`, `volQuantum_pos` : it vanishes iff some axis has `2` or `3` sites.
- `volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_x` (and `y`, `z`), `volQuantum_lt` : strict growth in each axis,
  below its limit.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The volumetric quantum

## iv. References

* H. P. Robertson, *A general formulation of the uncertainty principle and its classical
  interpretation*, Phys. Rev. 35 (1930) 667.

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum
declarations.doc:
The volumetric quantum of the cube `Nx × Ny × Nz`: the product of the dimensional quanta of
its axes, each axis carrying its own `C` (`uncertaintyRatio_alongX`, `uncertaintyRatio_alongY`,
`uncertaintyRatio_alongZ`).
declarations.statement: noncomputable def volQuantum : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc: The volumetric quantum vanishes iff some axis has `2` or `3` sites.
declarations.statement:
lemma volQuantum_eq_zero_iff (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 2 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 2 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 2 ≤ Tz.N) :
    volQuantum Tx Ty Tz = 0 ↔
      (Tx.N = 2 ∨ Tx.N = 3) ∨ (Ty.N = 2 ∨ Ty.N = 3) ∨ (Tz.N = 2 ∨ Tz.N = 3)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_pos
declarations.doc: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum is positive.
declarations.statement:
lemma volQuantum_pos (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0)
    (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N) : 0 < volQuantum Tx Ty Tz

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_x
declarations.doc: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum grows strictly along `x`.
declarations.statement:
lemma volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_x {Tx' : TightBindingChain} (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hx' : Tx'.t ≠ 0)
    (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N)
    (h : Tx.N < Tx'.N) : volQuantum Tx Ty Tz < volQuantum Tx' Ty Tz

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_y
declarations.doc: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum grows strictly along `y`.
declarations.statement:
lemma volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_y {Ty' : TightBindingChain} (hx : Tx.t ≠ 0) (hy : Ty.t ≠ 0)
    (hy' : Ty'.t ≠ 0) (hz : Tz.t ≠ 0) (hNx : 4 ≤ Tx.N) (hNy : 4 ≤ Ty.N) (hNz : 4 ≤ Tz.N)
    (h : Ty.N < Ty'.N) : volQuantum Tx Ty Tz < volQuantum Tx Ty' Tz

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.volQuantum_lt_volQuantum_z
declarations.doc: From `4 × 4 × 4` on, the volumetric quantum grows strictly along `z`.

modules.title: The current operator of the open tight binding chain
modules.doc:
The current operator `J = i (H X - X H)` of the open tight binding chain and its matrix elements.

## i. Overview

By the Heisenberg equation the velocity of the electron is `dX/dt = i [H, X]` (with `ħ = 1`).
On the open tight binding chain this current operator `J = i (H X - X H)` only moves the
electron to a neighbouring site, with amplitude `∓ i a t`. Stationary states and localized
states carry no current.

The current only sees the hopping part `K = H - E₀` of the Hamiltonian, its kinetic energy. With
position it closes on `K`: `J X - X J = i a² K`. With the Hamiltonian it gives the rate of change
of the current, and `H J - J H` is diagonal and vanishes inside the chain: the current changes only
at the two ends, `-2 i a t²` on the first site and `2 i a t²` on the last. Finally `K` and `J` share
no eigenvector: `K ψ = μ ψ` is a recurrence fixed by `ψ` on the first site, and `J ψ = 0` forces
`X ψ` to solve the same recurrence and vanish there.

## ii. Key results

- `current` : the current operator `J = i (H X - X H)`.
- `inner_current_eq` : `J` moves the electron exactly one site, with amplitude `∓ i a t`.
- `inner_current_self_of_eigen` : stationary states carry no current.
- `inner_current_localizedState` : localized states carry no current.
- `hopping` : the hopping part `K = H - E₀` of the Hamiltonian.
- `current_comp_position_sub` : `J X - X J = i a² K`.
- `inner_openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub` : `H J - J H` lives on the two ends of the chain.
- `eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul` : a solution of `K ψ = μ ψ` vanishing on the first site vanishes.
- `eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul_of_current_eq_zero` : `K` and `J` share no eigenvector.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The current operator
- B. Matrix elements
- C. States without current
- D. The hopping part of the Hamiltonian
- E. Commutators of the current
- F. The hopping and the current share no eigenvector

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]
