declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current
declarations.doc: The current operator `J = i (H X - X H)` of the open chain, the velocity `dX/dt`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def current : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_hermitian
declarations.doc: The current operator is hermitian.
declarations.statement:
lemma current_hermitian (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    ⟪T.current ψ, φ⟫_ℂ = ⟪ψ, T.current φ⟫_ℂ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current
declarations.doc: The matrix elements of `J` are those of `H`, weighted by `i` times the hopping distance.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_current (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.current |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      Complex.I * ((T.a * ((n : ℕ) - (m : ℕ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian |n⟩⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [current, LinearMap.smul_apply, inner_smul_right, inner_commutator_position, mul_assoc]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current_eq
declarations.doc:
The current moves the electron exactly one site, a distance `a`, with amplitude `∓ i a t`;
every other matrix element vanishes.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_current_eq (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.current |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      if (m : ℕ) + 1 = n then -(Complex.I * (T.a * T.t : ℝ))
      else if (n : ℕ) + 1 = m then Complex.I * (T.a * T.t : ℝ) else 0 := by
  rw [inner_current, inner_openHamiltonian]
  by_cases hA : (m : ℕ) + 1 = n
  · have hn : ((n : ℕ) : ℂ) = (m : ℕ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hA.symm
    simp only [hA, Fin.ext_iff, true_or, ite_true, show (m : ℕ) ≠ n by omega, ite_false]
    push_cast [hn]
    ring
  by_cases hB : (n : ℕ) + 1 = m
  · have hm : ((m : ℕ) : ℂ) = (n : ℕ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hB.symm
    simp only [hA, hB, Fin.ext_iff, or_true, ite_true, show (m : ℕ) ≠ n by omega, ite_false]
    push_cast [hm]
    ring
  split_ifs with h <;> simp_all

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current_self_of_eigen
declarations.doc: Stationary states carry no current: `⟨ψ|J|ψ⟩ = 0` whenever `H ψ = E ψ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_current_self_of_eigen {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} {E : ℝ}
    (h : T.openHamiltonian ψ = (E : ℂ) • ψ) : ⟪ψ, T.current ψ⟫_ℂ = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current_localizedState
declarations.doc: A localized electron carries no current: `⟨n|J|n⟩ = 0`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_current_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) : ⟪|n⟩, T.current |n⟩⟫_ℂ = 0 := by
  rw [inner_current, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.hopping
declarations.doc: The hopping part `K = H - E₀` of the open Hamiltonian: its kinetic energy.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def hopping : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_hopping
declarations.doc: `K` hops between neighbouring sites only, with amplitude `-t`, and has no diagonal.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_hopping (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.hopping |n⟩⟫_ℂ = if (m : ℕ) + 1 = n ∨ (n : ℕ) + 1 = m then -(T.t : ℂ) else 0 := by
  rw [hopping, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, inner_sub_right,
    inner_smul_right, inner_openHamiltonian, localizedState_orthonormal_eq_ite]
  by_cases h : m = n
  · subst h
    simp
  · simp [h]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_apply_eq_sum
declarations.doc: An operator in components: `⟨m|A ψ⟩ = ∑ n, ⟨m|A|n⟩ ⟨n|ψ⟩`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_apply_eq_sum (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) (m : Fin T.N)
    (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : ⟪|m⟩, A ψ⟫_ℂ = ∑ n, ⟪|m⟩, A |n⟩⟫_ℂ * ⟪|n⟩, ψ⟫_ℂ := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← T.localizedState.sum_repr' ψ]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, inner_sum, inner_smul_right, mul_comm]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.ext_localizedState
declarations.doc: Two vectors with the same components on every site are equal.
declarations.statement:
lemma ext_localizedState {ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace} (h : ∀ m, ⟪|m⟩, ψ⟫_ℂ = ⟪|m⟩, φ⟫_ℂ) : ψ = φ := by
  rw [← T.localizedState.sum_repr' ψ, ← T.localizedState.sum_repr' φ]
  simp only [h]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_eq_hopping
declarations.doc: The current only sees the hopping: `J = i (K X - X K)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma current_eq_hopping :
    T.current = Complex.I • (T.hopping ∘ₗ T.position - T.position ∘ₗ T.hopping)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_current_hopping
declarations.doc: The matrix elements of `J` are those of `K`, weighted by `i` times the hopping distance.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_current_hopping (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.current |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      Complex.I * ((T.a * ((n : ℕ) - (m : ℕ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ⟪|m⟩, T.hopping |n⟩⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [current_eq_hopping, LinearMap.smul_apply, inner_smul_right, inner_commutator_position,
    mul_assoc]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_comp_position_sub
declarations.doc: **Position and current close on the kinetic energy.** `J X - X J = i a² K`.
declarations.statement:
lemma current_comp_position_sub :
    T.current ∘ₗ T.position - T.position ∘ₗ T.current =
      (Complex.I * (T.a : ℂ) ^ 2) • T.hopping

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_hopping_comp_current_sub
declarations.doc: On the hopping, `⟨m|(K J - J K)|n⟩ = i a ∑ k, ⟨m|K|k⟩ ⟨k|K|n⟩ (n + m - 2 k)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_hopping_comp_current_sub (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (T.hopping ∘ₗ T.current - T.current ∘ₗ T.hopping) |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      ∑ k, Complex.I * T.a * ⟪|m⟩, T.hopping |k⟩⟫_ℂ * ⟪|k⟩, T.hopping |n⟩⟫_ℂ *
        (((n : ℕ) + (m : ℕ) - 2 * (k : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, inner_sub_right,
    T.inner_apply_eq_sum _ m, T.inner_apply_eq_sum T.current m, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [inner_current_hopping, inner_current_hopping]
  push_cast
  ring

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub
declarations.doc: The current commutes with `H` as with its hopping part: `H J - J H = K J - J K`.
declarations.statement:
lemma openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub :
    T.openHamiltonian ∘ₗ T.current - T.current ∘ₗ T.openHamiltonian =
      T.hopping ∘ₗ T.current - T.current ∘ₗ T.hopping

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub
declarations.doc:
**The current changes only at the two ends of the chain.** `H J - J H` is diagonal, with
entry `-2 i a t²` on the first site, `2 i a t²` on the last, and `0` inside the chain.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (T.openHamiltonian ∘ₗ T.current - T.current ∘ₗ T.openHamiltonian) |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      if m = n then 2 * Complex.I * T.a * T.t ^ 2 *
        ((if 1 ≤ (m : ℕ) then 1 else 0) - (if (m : ℕ) + 1 < T.N then 1 else 0)) else 0 := by
  rw [openHamiltonian_comp_current_sub, inner_hopping_comp_current_sub]
  by_cases h : m = n
  · subst h
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
    simp only [hopping_term_self, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sum_ite_succ_eq,
      sum_ite_eq_succ]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => T.hopping_term_ne h k

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul
declarations.doc:
**The recurrence of the hopping.** A solution of `K ψ = μ ψ` vanishing on the first site
vanishes: the row `n` fixes `ψ (n + 1)` from `ψ n` and `ψ (n - 1)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 0 < T.N) {μ : ℂ} {ψ : T.HilbertSpace}
    (h : T.hopping ψ = μ • ψ) (h0 : ⟪|(⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin T.N)⟩, ψ⟫_ℂ = 0) : ψ = 0 := by
  have htc : -(T.t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ht)
  have key : ∀ j (hj : j < T.N), ⟪|(⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin T.N)⟩, ψ⟫_ℂ = 0 := by
    intro j
    induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul_of_current_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**The hopping and the current share no eigenvector.** For `t ≠ 0` and `N ≥ 2`, `K ψ = μ ψ`
and `J ψ = 0` force `ψ = 0`: `X ψ` solves the same recurrence and vanishes on the first site, so
`ψ` lives on the first site, from which `K` moves it.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_hopping_eq_smul_of_current_eq_zero (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) {μ : ℂ}
    {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hK : T.hopping ψ = μ • ψ) (hJ : T.current ψ = 0) : ψ = 0

modules.title: The current eigenstates of the open tight binding chain
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The standing waves `sin ((n + 1) k π / (N + 1))` of the open chain vanish just outside both
ends. Dressed with the phase `iⁿ`, they diagonalize the current operator `J`: the state
`∑ n, iⁿ sin ((n + 1) k π / (N + 1)) |n⟩` moves with current `2 a t cos (k π / (N + 1))`.

## ii. Key results

- `currentEigenstate` : the current eigenstate with quantum number `k`.
- `current_currentEigenstate` : `J ψ_k = 2 a t cos (k π / (N + 1)) ψ_k`.
- `norm_sq_currentEigenstate` : `‖ψ_k‖² = (N + 1) / 2` for `1 ≤ k ≤ N`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The current eigenstates
- B. The eigenvalue equation
- C. The norm

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentEigenstate
declarations.doc: The current eigenstate `∑ n, iⁿ sin ((n + 1) k π / (N + 1)) |n⟩`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def currentEigenstate (k : ℕ) : T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentEigenvalue
declarations.doc: The current `2 a t cos (k π / (N + 1))` of the eigenstate with quantum number `k`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def currentEigenvalue (k : ℕ) : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_currentEigenstate
declarations.doc: The amplitude of the current eigenstate on the site `m`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_currentEigenstate (k : ℕ) (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.currentEigenstate k⟫_ℂ =
      Complex.I ^ (m : ℕ) * Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (k * Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) := by
  rw [currentEigenstate, T.localizedState_orthonormal.inner_right_fintype]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sum_ite_eq_of_unique
declarations.doc: A sum over the sites picking at most one site.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_ite_eq_of_unique {N : ℕ} (P : Fin N → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (v : ℂ)
    (h : ∀ n n', P n → P n' → n = n') (hv : (∀ n, ¬ P n) → v = 0) :
    ∑ n, (if P n then v else 0) = v

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_currentEigenstate
declarations.doc: The current eigenstates satisfy `J ψ_k = 2 a t cos (k π / (N + 1)) ψ_k`.
declarations.statement:
lemma current_currentEigenstate (k : ℕ) :
    T.current (T.currentEigenstate k) =
      (T.currentEigenvalue k : ℂ) • T.currentEigenstate k

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_sq_currentEigenstate
declarations.doc: The current eigenstates have squared norm `(N + 1) / 2` for `1 ≤ k ≤ N`.
declarations.statement:
lemma norm_sq_currentEigenstate {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k ≤ T.N) :
    ‖T.currentEigenstate k‖ ^ 2 = (T.N + 1) / 2

modules.title: Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao in the open tight binding chain
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The bracket `⁅H, X⁆ = -(i/2) (H X - X H)` is `-J / 2`, with `J = i (H X - X H)` the current, the
velocity `d⟨X⟩/dt`. The energy–position uncertainty relation therefore reads in two ways:

* **Mandelstam–Tamm**: `|⟨J⟩| ≤ 2 ΔH ΔX`, the position moves no faster than the energy spread
  allows;
* **quantum Cramér–Rao**: the error-propagation Fisher information `⟨J⟩² / Var X` of the position,
  for a displacement generated by `H`, is at most `4 Var H`, the quantum Fisher information of a
  pure state.

Both are the single statement `⟨J⟩² ≤ 4 Var H · Var X`, that is `mandelstamTammRatio ≤ 1`.

## ii. Key results

- `currentObservable` : the current `J` as an observable.
- `coe_bracket_openHamiltonian_position` : `⁅H, X⁆ = -J / 2`.
- `sq_expectation_current_le` : `⟨J⟩² ≤ 4 Var H · Var X`.
- `mandelstam_tamm` : `|⟨J⟩| ≤ 2 ΔH ΔX`.
- `cramer_rao` : `⟨J⟩² / Var X ≤ 4 Var H`.
- `mandelstamTammRatio` : `⟨J⟩² / (4 Var H · Var X)`, at most one by
  `mandelstamTammRatio_le_one`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The current as an observable
- B. Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## A. The current as an observable

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentObservable
declarations.doc: The current `J = i (H X - X H)` as an observable.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev currentObservable

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.coe_bracket_openHamiltonian_position
declarations.doc:
The bracket of the Hamiltonian and the position is minus half the current:
`⁅H, X⁆ = -J / 2`.
declarations.statement:
lemma coe_bracket_openHamiltonian_position :
    ((⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆ : Observable _) :
      T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) =
      (-(1 / 2) : ℂ) • (T.currentObservable : T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_bracket_openHamiltonian_position
declarations.doc: The expected bracket is minus half the expected current.
declarations.statement:
lemma expectation_bracket_openHamiltonian_position
    (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace]) :
    ω⟨⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆⟩ = -(ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩ / 2)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.sq_expectation_current_le
declarations.doc: In every state, `⟨J⟩² ≤ 4 Var H · Var X`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sq_expectation_current_le :
    ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 ≤
      4 * (variance ω T.openHamiltonianObservable * variance ω T.positionObservable)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstam_tamm
declarations.doc:
**Mandelstam–Tamm.** The position moves no faster than the energy spread allows:
`|d⟨X⟩/dt| = |⟨J⟩| ≤ 2 ΔH ΔX`.
declarations.statement:
lemma mandelstam_tamm :
    |ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩| ≤
      2 * (√(variance ω T.openHamiltonianObservable) * √(variance ω T.positionObservable))

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.cramer_rao
declarations.doc:
**Quantum Cramér–Rao.** For a displacement generated by `H`, the error-propagation Fisher
information `⟨J⟩² / Var X` of the position is at most `4 Var H`, the quantum Fisher information
of a pure state.
declarations.statement:
lemma cramer_rao :
    ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩ ^ 2 / variance ω T.positionObservable ≤
      4 * variance ω T.openHamiltonianObservable

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio
declarations.doc:
The Mandelstam–Tamm ratio `⟨J⟩² / (4 Var H · Var X)`: how close a state comes to both
Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def mandelstamTammRatio : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_le_one
declarations.doc: The Mandelstam–Tamm ratio never exceeds one.
declarations.statement: lemma mandelstamTammRatio_le_one : T.mandelstamTammRatio ω ≤ 1

modules.title: The speed limit of the open tight binding chain
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

For `t ≠ 0` the current eigenstates `ψ_1, …, ψ_N` carry distinct currents, so, normalized, they
form an orthonormal basis. Every current `2 a t cos (k π / (N + 1))` is at most
`maxCurrent = 2 |a t| cos (π / (N + 1))` in absolute value, hence so is the current `⟨J⟩` of
every state, pure or mixed: no state moves faster. The maximal current state reaches the bound.

## ii. Key results

- `currentBasis` : the orthonormal basis of normalized current eigenstates.
- `re_inner_current_eq_sum` : `re ⟨ψ|J|ψ⟩ = ∑ k, λ_k |⟨k|ψ⟩|²` in that basis.
- `abs_currentEigenvalue_le` : `|2 a t cos (k π / (N + 1))| ≤ maxCurrent` for `1 ≤ k ≤ N`.
- `expectation_current_maxCurrentState` : `⟨J⟩ = 2 a t cos (π / (N + 1))` in the maximal current
  state.
- `abs_expectation_current_le` : `|⟨J⟩| ≤ maxCurrent` in every state.
- `abs_expectation_current_maxCurrentState` : the maximal current state moves at `maxCurrent`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The largest current
- B. The basis of current eigenstates
- C. No state is faster

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## B. The basis of current eigenstates

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrent
declarations.doc: The largest current `2 |a t| cos (π / (N + 1))` of the open chain.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def maxCurrent : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.abs_currentEigenvalue_le
declarations.doc: Every current eigenvalue is at most `maxCurrent` in absolute value.
declarations.statement:
lemma abs_currentEigenvalue_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k ≤ T.N) :
    |T.currentEigenvalue k| ≤ T.maxCurrent

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentBasisVec
declarations.doc: The normalized current eigenstates `ψ_{k+1}`, `k < N`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def currentBasisVec (k : Fin T.N) : T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_currentBasisVec
declarations.statement: lemma norm_currentBasisVec (k : Fin T.N) : ‖T.currentBasisVec k‖ = 1

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.orthonormal_currentBasisVec
declarations.doc: The normalized current eigenstates are orthonormal.
declarations.statement: lemma orthonormal_currentBasisVec (ht : T.t ≠ 0) : Orthonormal ℂ T.currentBasisVec

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentBasis
declarations.doc: The orthonormal basis of normalized current eigenstates.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def currentBasis (ht : T.t ≠ 0) : OrthonormalBasis (Fin T.N) ℂ T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_currentBasis
declarations.doc: The current on the basis of current eigenstates.
declarations.statement:
lemma current_currentBasis (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (k : Fin T.N) :
    T.current (T.currentBasis ht k) =
      (T.currentEigenvalue ((k : ℕ) + 1) : ℂ) • T.currentBasis ht k

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.re_inner_current_eq_sum
declarations.doc:
The mean current in the basis of current eigenstates:
`re ⟨ψ|J|ψ⟩ = ∑ k, λ_k |⟨k|ψ⟩|²`.
declarations.statement:
lemma re_inner_current_eq_sum (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    (⟪ψ, T.current ψ⟫_ℂ).re =
      ∑ k : Fin T.N, T.currentEigenvalue ((k : ℕ) + 1) * ‖⟪T.currentBasis ht k, ψ⟫_ℂ‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.abs_re_inner_current_le
declarations.doc: In every vector, `|re ⟨ψ|J|ψ⟩| ≤ maxCurrent ‖ψ‖²`.
declarations.statement:
lemma abs_re_inner_current_le (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    |(⟪ψ, T.current ψ⟫_ℂ).re| ≤ T.maxCurrent * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.abs_expectation_current_le
declarations.doc:
**Speed limit.** In every state, `|⟨J⟩| ≤ maxCurrent`: no state of the open chain moves
faster than `2 |a t| cos (π / (N + 1))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma abs_expectation_current_le (ht : T.t ≠ 0)
    (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace]) :
    |ω⟨T.currentObservable⟩| ≤ T.maxCurrent

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_current_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state carries the current `⟨J⟩ = 2 a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma expectation_current_maxCurrentState :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.currentObservable⟩ =
      2 * (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.abs_expectation_current_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state moves at the speed limit.
declarations.statement:
lemma abs_expectation_current_maxCurrentState :
    |T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.currentObservable⟩| = T.maxCurrent

modules.title: Time reversal in the open tight binding chain
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

Time reversal `Θ` conjugates the amplitudes of a state in the site basis. It is antiunitary. The
Hamiltonian and the position operator have real matrix elements, so they commute with `Θ`, while
the current `J = i (H X - X H)` changes sign.

## ii. Key results

- `timeReversal` : complex conjugation of amplitudes.
- `inner_timeReversal`, `norm_timeReversal` : `Θ` is antiunitary.
- `apply_timeReversal` : an operator with real matrix elements commutes with `Θ`.
- `openHamiltonian_timeReversal`, `position_timeReversal` : `H` and `X` commute with `Θ`.
- `current_timeReversal` : `Θ` reverses the current.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Time reversal

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal
declarations.doc: Time reversal: complex conjugation of the amplitudes.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_val
declarations.statement:
lemma timeReversal_val (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) (n : Fin T.N) :
    (T.timeReversal ψ).val n = (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ.val n)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_sub
declarations.statement:
lemma timeReversal_sub (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.timeReversal (ψ - φ) = T.timeReversal ψ - T.timeReversal φ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma timeReversal_smul (c : ℂ) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.timeReversal (c • ψ) = (starRingEnd ℂ) c • T.timeReversal ψ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.timeReversal_real_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma timeReversal_real_smul (r : ℝ) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.timeReversal (r • ψ) = r • T.timeReversal ψ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_timeReversal
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_timeReversal (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    ⟪T.timeReversal ψ, T.timeReversal φ⟫_ℂ = (starRingEnd ℂ) ⟪ψ, φ⟫_ℂ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_timeReversal
declarations.statement: lemma norm_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : ‖T.timeReversal ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.apply_timeReversal
declarations.doc: An operator with real matrix elements commutes with time reversal.
declarations.statement:
lemma apply_timeReversal {A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace}
    (hA : ∀ n m, (starRingEnd ℂ) ⟪|n⟩, A |m⟩⟫_ℂ = ⟪|n⟩, A |m⟩⟫_ℂ) (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    A (T.timeReversal ψ) = T.timeReversal (A ψ) := by
  ext n
  rw [val_apply, timeReversal_val, val_apply, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => by
    rw [map_mul, timeReversal_val, val_apply_basisFun]
    exact congrArg (· * _) (hA n m).symm

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.openHamiltonian_timeReversal
declarations.statement:
lemma openHamiltonian_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.openHamiltonian (T.timeReversal ψ) = T.timeReversal (T.openHamiltonian ψ)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.position_timeReversal
declarations.statement:
lemma position_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.position (T.timeReversal ψ) = T.timeReversal (T.position ψ)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_timeReversal
declarations.doc: Time reversal reverses the current.
declarations.statement:
lemma current_timeReversal (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    T.current (T.timeReversal ψ) = -T.timeReversal (T.current ψ)

modules.title: The maximal current state of the open tight binding chain
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The longest standing wave, the current eigenstate with `k = 1`, carries the largest current
`2 a t cos (π / (N + 1))` among the current eigenstates when `t ≥ 0`. Normalized, it is the
maximal current state. It sits at
the centre of the chain, `⟨X⟩ = a (N - 1) / 2`, at the centre of the band, `⟨H⟩ = E0`, and
`⟨⁅H, X⁆⟩ = -a t cos (π / (N + 1))` is the bound of its energy–position uncertainty relation.

## ii. Key results

- `currentEigenvalue_le_one` : for `t ≥ 0`, `k = 1` carries the largest current.
- `inner_openHamiltonian_currentEigenstate` : the Hamiltonian on the current eigenstates.
- `maxCurrentState` : the maximal current state, of norm one by `norm_maxCurrentState`.
- `expectation_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState` : `⟨H⟩ = E0`.
- `expectation_position_maxCurrentState` : `⟨X⟩ = a (N - 1) / 2`.
- `expectation_bracket_maxCurrentState` : `⟨⁅H, X⁆⟩ = -a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
- `robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState` : the energy–position uncertainty relation of the maximal
  current state.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The largest current
- B. The Hamiltonian on the current eigenstates
- C. The maximal current state
- D. Expectations

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## B. The Hamiltonian on the current eigenstates

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.currentEigenvalue_le_one
declarations.doc: For `t ≥ 0`, the current eigenstate with `k = 1` carries the largest current.
declarations.statement:
lemma currentEigenvalue_le_one (ht : 0 ≤ T.t) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkN : k ≤ T.N) :
    T.currentEigenvalue k ≤ T.currentEigenvalue 1

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_openHamiltonian_currentEigenstate
declarations.doc:
The Hamiltonian on the current eigenstates:
`⟨m|H ψ_k⟩ = E0 ⟨m|ψ_k⟩ - 2 t sin θ iᵐ⁺¹ cos ((m + 1) θ)` with `θ = k π / (N + 1)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_openHamiltonian_currentEigenstate (k : ℕ) (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian (T.currentEigenstate k)⟫_ℂ =
      T.E0 * ⟪|m⟩, T.currentEigenstate k⟫_ℂ - 2 * T.t * Real.sin (k * Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) *
        Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1) * Real.cos (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (k * Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) := by
  have hN : Real.sin (((T.N : ℝ) + 1) * (k * Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)]
    exact Real.sin_nat_mul_pi k
  rw [inner_currentEigenstate]
  simp only [currentEigenstate, map_sum, map_smul, inner_sum, inner_smul_right,
    inner_openHamiltonian]
  generalize (k : ℝ) * Real.pi / (T.N + 1) = θ at hN ⊢
  have key (n : Fin T.N) : Complex.I ^ (n : ℕ) * Real.sin (((n : ℕ) + 1) * θ) *
      (if m = n then (T.E0 : ℂ)
        else if (m : ℕ) + 1 = n ∨ (n : ℕ) + 1 = m then -(T.t : ℂ) else 0) =
      (if m = n then T.E0 * (Complex.I ^ (m : ℕ) * Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 1) * θ)) else 0) +
      ((if (m : ℕ) + 1 = n then -(T.t * Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1) *
        Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 2) * θ)) else 0) +
      if (n : ℕ) + 1 = m then T.t * Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1) *
        Real.sin ((m : ℕ) * θ) else 0) := by
    by_cases hmn : m = n
    · subst hmn
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_right (by omega)]
      ring
    by_cases hA : (m : ℕ) + 1 = n
    · have hn : (n : ℕ) = m + 1 := hA.symm
      simp only [hmn, hn, true_or, show ¬ ((m : ℕ) + 1 + 1 = m) by omega, ite_true,
        ite_false, zero_add, add_zero]
      rw [show (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) = (m : ℕ) + 2 by push_cast; ring]
      ring
    by_cases hB : (n : ℕ) + 1 = m
    · simp only [hmn, hA, hB, or_true, ite_true, ite_false, zero_add]
      rw [← hB, Nat.cast_add_one, pow_succ, pow_succ]
      linear_combination (-(T.t : ℂ) * Complex.I ^ (n : ℕ) *
        Real.sin (((n : ℕ) + 1) * θ)) * Complex.I_sq
    · simp [hmn, hA, hB]
  have hv1 (h : ∀ n : Fin T.N, ¬ ((m : ℕ) + 1 = n)) : Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 2) * θ) = 0 := by
    have hm : (m : ℕ) + 1 = T.N := by
      by_contra hne
      exact h ⟨(m : ℕ) + 1, by omega⟩ rfl
    have hm' : ((m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = T.N := by exact_mod_cast hm
    rw [show ((m : ℕ) + 2 : ℝ) = T.N + 1 by linarith, hN]
  have hv2 (h : ∀ n : Fin T.N, ¬ ((n : ℕ) + 1 = m)) : Real.sin ((m : ℕ) * θ) = 0 := by
    have hm : (m : ℕ) = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact h ⟨(m : ℕ) - 1, by omega⟩ (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega))
    simp [hm]
  have hr : Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 2) * θ) - Real.sin ((m : ℕ) * θ) =
      2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos (((m : ℕ) + 1) * θ) := by
    rw [show ((m : ℕ) + 2) * θ = ((m : ℕ) + 1) * θ + θ by ring,
      show ((m : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ = ((m : ℕ) + 1) * θ - θ by ring, Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => key n, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_univ _),
    sum_ite_eq_of_unique _ _ (fun n n' h h' => Fin.ext (by omega)) fun h => by simp [hv1 h],
    sum_ite_eq_of_unique _ _ (fun n n' h h' => Fin.ext (by omega)) fun h => by simp [hv2 h]]
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) hr
  push_cast at hc ⊢
  linear_combination (-(T.t : ℂ) * Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1)) * hc

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state: the current eigenstate with `k = 1`, times `√(2 / (N + 1))`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def maxCurrentState : T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state has norm one.
declarations.statement: lemma norm_maxCurrentState : ‖T.maxCurrentState‖ = 1

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The amplitude of the maximal current state on the site `m`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_maxCurrentState (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ = (√(2 / (T.N + 1)) : ℝ) *
      (Complex.I ^ (m : ℕ) * Real.sin (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))) := by
  rw [maxCurrentState, inner_smul_right, inner_currentEigenstate, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The Hamiltonian on the maximal current state, site by site.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ = T.E0 * ⟪|m⟩, T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ -
      (√(2 / (T.N + 1)) : ℝ) * (2 * T.t * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) *
        Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1) * Real.cos (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))) := by
  rw [maxCurrentState, map_smul, inner_smul_right, inner_openHamiltonian_currentEigenstate,
    inner_smul_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  ring

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.current_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state carries the current `2 a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma current_maxCurrentState :
    T.current T.maxCurrentState = (T.currentEigenvalue 1 : ℂ) • T.maxCurrentState

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.maxCurrentVectorState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state as a state on the operators of the chain.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev maxCurrentVectorState :
    𝓢[ℂ, T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: Expectations in the maximal current state are real parts of its diagonal matrix elements.
declarations.statement:
lemma expectation_maxCurrentState (A : Observable (T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace)) :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨A⟩ =
      (⟪T.maxCurrentState, (A : T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ).re

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state sits at the centre of the band, `⟨H⟩ = E0`.
declarations.statement:
lemma expectation_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.openHamiltonianObservable⟩ = T.E0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_position_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The maximal current state sits at the centre of the chain, `⟨X⟩ = a (N - 1) / 2`.
declarations.statement:
lemma expectation_position_maxCurrentState :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.positionObservable⟩ = T.a * (T.N - 1) / 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_bracket_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The bracket of the maximal current state: `⟨⁅H, X⁆⟩ = -a t cos (π / (N + 1))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma expectation_bracket_maxCurrentState :
    T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆⟩ =
      -(T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)))

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc:
**Energy–position uncertainty of the maximal current state.**
`Cov(H, X)² + (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))² ≤ Var H · Var X` in the maximal current state.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState :
    covariance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable ^ 2 +
        (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 ≤
      variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable

modules.title: The fluctuation angle of the maximal current state
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In the maximal current state the energy and position fluctuations are uncorrelated, so the
pairing `ω(δH δX)` reduces to the bracket term `a t cos (π / (N + 1))`. Its modulus over
`σ_H σ_X` is the cosine of the angle between the two fluctuations: the fluctuation angle, with
`cos θ = 1 / C`. It vanishes exactly for `N = 2, 3`, opens from four sites on, grows
strictly with `N` and stays below `arccos (1 / √(π² / 3 - 2))`. The excess `δ = C - 1` is the
dimensional quantum of the chain, and it fixes the angle.

## ii. Key results

- `fluctuationAngle` : the angle between the energy and position fluctuations.
- `fluctuationAngle_eq` : `θ = arccos (1 / C)`.
- `fluctuationAngle_eq_zero_iff`, `fluctuationAngle_pos` : it vanishes iff `N = 2, 3`, and opens
  from `N = 4`.
- `fluctuationAngle_lt_fluctuationAngle`, `fluctuationAngle_lt` : it grows strictly with `N`, below
  its limit.
- `dimQuantum` : the dimensional quantum `δ = C - 1`.
- `fluctuationAngle_eq_dimQuantum` : `θ = arccos (1 / (1 + δ))`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The fluctuation angle
- B. The dimensional quantum

## iv. References

* H. P. Robertson, *A general formulation of the uncertainty principle and its classical
  interpretation*, Phys. Rev. 35 (1930) 667.

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle
declarations.doc:
The fluctuation angle: the angle between the energy and position fluctuations in the maximal
current state, `arccos (‖ω(δH δX)‖ / (σ_H σ_X))`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def fluctuationAngle : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_eq
declarations.doc: The fluctuation angle: `cos θ = 1 / C`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fluctuationAngle_eq (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle = Real.arccos (1 / T.uncertaintyRatio)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc: The fluctuation angle vanishes exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fluctuationAngle_eq_zero_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle = 0 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_pos
declarations.doc: From four sites on, the fluctuation angle is open.
declarations.statement: lemma fluctuationAngle_pos (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) : 0 < T.fluctuationAngle

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_lt_fluctuationAngle
declarations.doc: From four sites on, the fluctuation angle grows strictly with the number of sites.
declarations.statement:
lemma fluctuationAngle_lt_fluctuationAngle {T T' : TightBindingChain} (ht : T.t ≠ 0)
    (ht' : T'.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) (hNN' : T.N < T'.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle < T'.fluctuationAngle

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_lt
declarations.doc: From four sites on, the fluctuation angle stays below `arccos (1 / √(π² / 3 - 2))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fluctuationAngle_lt (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle < Real.arccos (1 / √(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2))

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum
declarations.doc: The dimensional quantum of the chain: the excess `C - 1` over saturation.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def dimQuantum : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_nonneg
declarations.statement: lemma dimQuantum_nonneg (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) : 0 ≤ T.dimQuantum

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc: The dimensional quantum vanishes exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
declarations.statement:
lemma dimQuantum_eq_zero_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.dimQuantum = 0 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_pos
declarations.doc: From four sites on, the dimensional quantum is positive.
declarations.statement: lemma dimQuantum_pos (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) : 0 < T.dimQuantum

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_lt_dimQuantum
declarations.doc: From four sites on, the dimensional quantum grows strictly with the number of sites.
declarations.statement:
lemma dimQuantum_lt_dimQuantum {T T' : TightBindingChain} (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (ht' : T'.t ≠ 0)
    (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) (hNN' : T.N < T'.N) : T.dimQuantum < T'.dimQuantum

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.dimQuantum_lt
declarations.doc: From four sites on, the dimensional quantum stays below `√(π² / 3 - 2) - 1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma dimQuantum_lt (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.dimQuantum < √(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2) - 1

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluctuationAngle_eq_dimQuantum
declarations.doc: The dimensional quantum fixes the fluctuation angle: `θ = arccos (1 / (1 + δ))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fluctuationAngle_eq_dimQuantum (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.fluctuationAngle = Real.arccos (1 / (1 + T.dimQuantum))

modules.title: The long chain limit of `C`
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In the maximal current state, `C` depends only on the number of sites `N`. As the chain
grows, `θ = π / (N + 1) → 0`, `(N + 1) sin θ → π` and `cos θ → 1`, so the closed form of
`C²` tends to `2 (π² / 6 - 1) = π² / 3 - 2`. Every long enough chain has
`C` close to `C_∞ = √(π² / 3 - 2) ≈ 1.1357`, which is strictly larger than one: the
uncertainty relation stays strict in the long chain limit.

## ii. Key results

- `uncertaintyRatioSqForm` : the closed form of `C²` as a function of `n = N + 1`.
- `uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq_uncertaintyRatioSqForm` : `C² = uncertaintyRatioSqForm (N + 1)` for
  `N ≥ 2`.
- `tendsto_uncertaintyRatioSqForm` : `uncertaintyRatioSqForm n → π² / 3 - 2` as `n → ∞`.
- `tendsto_uncertaintyRatio` : `C → √(π² / 3 - 2)` along any family of chains with `N → ∞`.
- `one_lt_sqrt_pi_sq_div_three_sub_two` : `1 < √(π² / 3 - 2)`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The limit of the closed form
- B. The limit of `C`

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## A. The limit of the closed form

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatioSqForm
declarations.doc: The closed form of `C²` as a function of `n = N + 1`, written with `sinc`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def uncertaintyRatioSqForm (n : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.tendsto_uncertaintyRatioSqForm
declarations.doc: The closed form tends to `π² / 3 - 2` as `n → ∞`.
declarations.statement:
lemma tendsto_uncertaintyRatioSqForm :
    Tendsto uncertaintyRatioSqForm atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2))

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq_uncertaintyRatioSqForm
declarations.doc: For `N ≥ 2`, `C²` is the closed form at `n = N + 1`.

    T.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2 = uncertaintyRatioSqForm (T.N + 1)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.tendsto_uncertaintyRatio
declarations.doc:
**The long chain limit.** Along any family of chains whose number of sites tends to infinity,
the constant `C` of the maximal current state tends to `√(π² / 3 - 2)`.

declarations.doc: The limit `√(π² / 3 - 2)` is strictly larger than one, since `π > 3`.
declarations.statement: lemma one_lt_sqrt_pi_sq_div_three_sub_two : 1 < √(Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - 2)

modules.title: `C` grows with the length of the chain
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

From four sites on, `C` of the maximal current state is strictly increasing in the number
of sites `N`, and so it stays strictly below its long chain limit `√(π² / 3 - 2)`. With
`x = π / (N + 1)`, the closed form of `C²` is
`((π² / x² - 2π / x - 4 + 8x / π) / 3) tan² x - 2 + 4x / π`, whose derivative is negative on
`0 < x ≤ π / 5`. The sign follows from Taylor bounds for `sin` and `cos`, the bounds
`3.141592 < π < 3.141593`, and a Bernstein certificate for one polynomial of degree twelve.

## ii. Key results

- `uncertaintyRatioSqForm_strictMonoOn` : the closed form of `C²` is strictly increasing on `n ≥ 5`.
- `uncertaintyRatio_lt_uncertaintyRatio` : `C` strictly increases with `N` from four sites on.
- `uncertaintyRatio_lt_sqrt_pi_sq_div_three_sub_two` : `C < √(π² / 3 - 2)` from four sites on.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Taylor bounds
- B. A polynomial certificate
- C. The closed form in the angle
- D. Monotonicity

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## C. The closed form in the angle

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatioSqForm_strictMonoOn
declarations.doc: The closed form of `C²` is strictly increasing on `n ≥ 5`, that is, from four sites on.
declarations.statement: lemma uncertaintyRatioSqForm_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn uncertaintyRatioSqForm (Ici 5)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_lt_uncertaintyRatio

declarations.statement:

    T.uncertaintyRatio < T'.uncertaintyRatio

modules.title: Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao in the maximal current state
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In the maximal current state the current is `⟨J⟩ = 2 a t cos (π / (N + 1))`
(`expectation_current_maxCurrentState`), and the Mandelstam–Tamm ratio
`⟨J⟩² / (4 Var H · Var X)` is exactly `1 / C²`. Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao are therefore
attained together, exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`, and both are missed from four sites on.

## ii. Key results

- `mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState` : the ratio is `1 / C²`.
- `mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_eq_one_iff` : both bounds are attained iff `N = 2, 3`.
- `mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_lt_one` : both are missed for `N ≥ 4`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The Mandelstam–Tamm ratio of the maximal current state

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## A. The Mandelstam–Tamm ratio of the maximal current state

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: In the maximal current state the Mandelstam–Tamm ratio is `1 / C²`.
declarations.statement:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState :
    T.mandelstamTammRatio T.maxCurrentVectorState = 1 / T.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_eq_one_iff
declarations.doc: Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao are attained in the maximal current state iff `N = 2, 3`.
declarations.statement:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_eq_one_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.mandelstamTammRatio T.maxCurrentVectorState = 1 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_lt_one
declarations.doc: From four sites on, the maximal current state misses Mandelstam–Tamm and Cramér–Rao.
declarations.statement:
lemma mandelstamTammRatio_maxCurrentState_lt_one (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.mandelstamTammRatio T.maxCurrentVectorState < 1

modules.title: Saturation of the uncertainty relation in the maximal current state
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The energy–position uncertainty relation is an equality exactly when the centered Gram defect
vanishes, that is when the energy and position fluctuations of the state are parallel. In the
maximal current state of an open chain with `N ≥ 2` sites and hopping `t ≠ 0` this happens only
for `N = 2` and `N = 3`: the first two sites force `4 cos² (π / (N + 1)) = N - 1`. From four
sites on, the relation is strict.

## ii. Key results

- `inner_energyFluctuation_maxCurrentState` : the energy fluctuation, site by site.
- `inner_positionFluctuation_maxCurrentState` : the position fluctuation, site by site.
- `centeredGramDefect_maxCurrentState_eq_zero_iff` : the defect vanishes iff `N = 2, 3`.
- `robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_eq_iff` : the relation is an equality iff `N = 2, 3`.
- `robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_lt` : the relation is strict for `N ≥ 4`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The fluctuations
- B. Saturation

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_energyFluctuation_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The energy fluctuation of the maximal current state, site by site.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_energyFluctuation_maxCurrentState (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (T.openHamiltonianObservable : T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) T.maxCurrentState -
      T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.openHamiltonianObservable⟩ • T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ =
      -((√(2 / (T.N + 1)) : ℝ) * (2 * T.t * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) *
        Complex.I ^ ((m : ℕ) + 1) * Real.cos (((m : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))))) := by
  rw [expectation_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState, inner_sub_right, ← Complex.coe_smul,
    inner_smul_right]
  change ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ - _ = _
  rw [inner_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState]
  ring

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_positionFluctuation_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The position fluctuation of the maximal current state, site by site.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_positionFluctuation_maxCurrentState (m : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (T.positionObservable : T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) T.maxCurrentState -
      T.maxCurrentVectorState⟨T.positionObservable⟩ • T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ =
      (T.a * ((m : ℕ) - (T.N - 1) / 2) : ℝ) * ⟪|m⟩, T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [expectation_position_maxCurrentState, inner_sub_right, ← Complex.coe_smul,
    inner_smul_right]
  change ⟪|m⟩, T.position T.maxCurrentState⟫_ℂ - _ = _
  rw [← position_hermitian, position_apply_localizedState, inner_smul_left, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  push_cast
  ring

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_maxCurrentState_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
In the maximal current state of a chain with `N ≥ 2` sites and hopping `t ≠ 0`, the centered
Gram defect of `H` and `X` vanishes exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
declarations.statement:
lemma centeredGramDefect_maxCurrentState_eq_zero_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    centeredGramDefect T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable
      T.positionObservable = 0 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_eq_iff
declarations.doc:
**Saturation.** In the maximal current state of a chain with `N ≥ 2` sites and hopping
`t ≠ 0`, the energy–position uncertainty relation is an equality exactly for `N = 2, 3`.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_eq_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    covariance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable ^ 2 +
        (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 =
      variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_lt
declarations.doc: From four sites on, the uncertainty relation of the maximal current state is strict.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_maxCurrentState_lt (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    covariance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable ^ 2 +
        (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 <
      variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable

modules.title: The elemental uncertainty of the open tight binding chain
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In the maximal current state of the open chain the energy and position fluctuations are
uncorrelated, so the uncertainty relation closes as an identity: the variance product is the
squared bracket `(a t cos (π / (N + 1)))²` plus the centered Gram defect. The uncertainty ratio
`C = √(Var H · Var X) / |a t cos (π / (N + 1))|` is therefore at least one, and equals one exactly
for `N = 2` and `N = 3`. From four sites on it is strictly larger than one.

## ii. Key results

- `covariance_maxCurrentState` : `Cov(H, X) = 0` in the maximal current state.
- `variance_mul_variance_maxCurrentState` : `Var H · Var X = (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))² + defect`.
- `uncertaintyRatio` : `C = √(Var H · Var X) / |a t cos (π / (N + 1))|`.
- `one_le_uncertaintyRatio`, `uncertaintyRatio_eq_one_iff`, `one_lt_uncertaintyRatio`.
- `robertson_schrodinger_uncertaintyRatio` : everything at once.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. No correlation
- B. The uncertainty ratio `C`

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.covariance_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The energy and position fluctuations of the maximal current state are uncorrelated.
declarations.statement:
lemma covariance_maxCurrentState :
    covariance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_mul_variance_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc:
The uncertainty identity of the maximal current state:
`Var H · Var X = (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))² + defect`.
declarations.statement:
lemma variance_mul_variance_maxCurrentState :
    variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable =
      (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 +
        centeredGramDefect T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable
          T.positionObservable

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio
declarations.doc:
The uncertainty ratio `C = √(Var H · Var X) / |a t cos (π / (N + 1))|` of the maximal current
state: the uncertainty product over its Robertson bound.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def uncertaintyRatio : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.bound_ne_zero
declarations.doc: The bound `a t cos (π / (N + 1))` is nonzero for `t ≠ 0` and `N ≥ 2`.
declarations.statement:
lemma bound_ne_zero (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ≠ 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.one_le_uncertaintyRatio
declarations.doc: `C` is at least one.
declarations.statement: lemma one_le_uncertaintyRatio (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) : 1 ≤ T.uncertaintyRatio

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_eq_one_iff
declarations.doc: `C` equals one exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
declarations.statement:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_eq_one_iff (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.uncertaintyRatio = 1 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.one_lt_uncertaintyRatio
declarations.doc: From four sites on, `C` is strictly larger than one.
declarations.statement: lemma one_lt_uncertaintyRatio (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) : 1 < T.uncertaintyRatio

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_uncertaintyRatio
declarations.doc:
The Robertson–Schrödinger relation through the uncertainty ratio. In the maximal
current state, `Var H · Var X = (a t cos (π / (N + 1)))² + defect`, `C` is at least one, and
it equals one exactly for `N = 2` and `N = 3`.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_uncertaintyRatio (ht : T.t ≠ 0)
    (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable *
        variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable =
      (T.a * T.t * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1))) ^ 2 +
        centeredGramDefect T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable
          T.positionObservable ∧
      1 ≤ T.uncertaintyRatio ∧ (T.uncertaintyRatio = 1 ↔ T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3)

modules.title: The variances of the maximal current state
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

In the maximal current state of the open chain with `N` sites, write `θ = π / (N + 1)`. The energy
and position variances are

  `Var H = 4 t² sin² θ (N - 1) / (N + 1)`,
  `Var X = a² (((N + 1)² + 2) / 12 - 1 / (2 sin² θ))`.

The position variance rests on one sum over the `(N + 1)`-th roots of unity,
`∑ j < N + 1, (j - (N + 1) / 2)² cos (2 j θ) = (N + 1) / (2 sin² θ)`, obtained by summation by
parts. Hence `C²` has the closed form
`2 (N - 1) / ((N + 1) cos² θ) · (((N + 1)² + 2) / 6 · sin² θ - 1)`.

## ii. Key results

- `variance_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState` : `Var H = 4 t² sin² θ (N - 1) / (N + 1)`.
- `variance_position_maxCurrentState` : `Var X = a² (((N + 1)² + 2) / 12 - 1 / (2 sin² θ))`.
- `uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq` : the closed form of `C²`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Sums over the roots of unity
- B. The energy variance
- C. The position variance
- D. The closed form of `C`

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## A. Sums over the roots of unity

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc: The energy variance of the maximal current state, `Var H = 4 t² sin² θ (N - 1) / (N + 1)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma variance_openHamiltonian_maxCurrentState :
    variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.openHamiltonianObservable =
      4 * T.t ^ 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2 * (T.N - 1) / (T.N + 1)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.variance_position_maxCurrentState
declarations.doc:
The position variance of the maximal current state,
`Var X = a² (((N + 1)² + 2) / 12 - 1 / (2 sin² θ))`.
declarations.statement:
lemma variance_position_maxCurrentState :
    variance T.maxCurrentVectorState T.positionObservable =
      T.a ^ 2 * (((T.N + 1) ^ 2 + 2) / 12 - 1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2))

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq
declarations.doc:
The closed form of `C²` in the maximal current state, with `θ = π / (N + 1)`:
`C² = 2 (N - 1) / ((N + 1) cos² θ) · (((N + 1)² + 2) / 6 · sin² θ - 1)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma uncertaintyRatio_sq_eq (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) :
    T.uncertaintyRatio ^ 2 = 2 * (T.N - 1) / ((T.N + 1) * Real.cos (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2) *
      (((T.N + 1) ^ 2 + 2) / 6 * Real.sin (Real.pi / (T.N + 1)) ^ 2 - 1)

modules.title: The tight binding chain with open boundary conditions
modules.doc:
The position operator and the Hamiltonian of the tight binding chain with open boundaries.

## i. Overview

A finite piece of a 1d solid has two ends: the electron cannot hop from the last site back to
the first. This is the tight binding chain with open boundary conditions. It also carries a
position operator, which the periodic chain lacks, since there the site `N` is identified
with the site `0`.

## ii. Key results

- `position` : the position operator `X = ∑ n, a n |n⟩⟨n|`.
- `openHamiltonian` : the Hamiltonian with open boundary conditions.
- `inner_openHamiltonian` : the open chain only hops between neighbouring sites.
- `inner_commutator_position` : `⟨m|(A X - X A)|n⟩ = a (n - m) ⟨m|A|n⟩`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The position operator
- B. The Hamiltonian with open boundary conditions
  - B.1. Hermiticity
  - B.2. Matrix elements
- C. Commutators with the position operator

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## B. The Hamiltonian with open boundary conditions
## C. Commutators with the position operator

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.position
declarations.doc: The position operator `X = ∑ n, a n |n⟩⟨n|`, measuring from the site `0`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def position : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.position_apply_localizedState
declarations.doc: The localized states are the eigenstates of the position operator.
declarations.statement:
lemma position_apply_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) :
    T.position |n⟩ = ((T.a * (n : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ) • |n⟩ := by
  simp [position, localizedComp_apply_localizedState]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.position_hermitian
declarations.doc: The position operator is hermitian.
declarations.statement:
lemma position_hermitian (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    ⟪T.position ψ, φ⟫_ℂ = ⟪ψ, T.position φ⟫_ℂ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.openHamiltonian
declarations.doc:
The Hamiltonian of the tight binding chain with open boundary conditions: the periodic
`hamiltonian` with one hopping between the end sites `0` and `N - 1` removed. For `N = 2` the
periodic chain counts the single bond twice, and one copy remains.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def openHamiltonian : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.openHamiltonian_hermitian
declarations.doc: The Hamiltonian with open boundary conditions is hermitian.
declarations.statement:
lemma openHamiltonian_hermitian (ψ φ : T.HilbertSpace) :
    ⟪T.openHamiltonian ψ, φ⟫_ℂ = ⟪ψ, T.openHamiltonian φ⟫_ℂ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_openHamiltonian
declarations.doc: The open chain hops only between neighbouring sites, with amplitude `-t`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_openHamiltonian (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      if m = n then (T.E0 : ℂ)
      else if (m : ℕ) + 1 = n ∨ (n : ℕ) + 1 = m then -(T.t : ℂ) else 0 := by
  simp only [openHamiltonian, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    hamiltonian_apply_localizedState, localizedComp_apply_localizedState, inner_add_right,
    inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right, localizedState_orthonormal_eq_ite]
  rw [apply_ite (inner ℂ _), apply_ite (inner ℂ _)]
  simp only [inner_zero_right, localizedState_orthonormal_eq_ite]
  have h (k l : Fin T.N) : k = l - 1 ↔ l = k + 1 := by rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, eq_comm]
  have hl (k : Fin T.N) : -1 = k ↔ (k : ℕ) + 1 = T.N := by
    rw [neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm, eq_comm, eq_add_one_iff_val]
    simp
  simp only [h m n, hl n, eq_comm (a := m) (b := -1), hl m, eq_add_one_iff_val m n,
    eq_add_one_iff_val n m]
  simp only [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero]
  split_ifs <;> first | omega | ring

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_commutator_position
declarations.doc:
Commuting with the position operator weighs each matrix element by the hopping distance:
`⟨m|(A X - X A)|n⟩ = a (n - m) ⟨m|A|n⟩`.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_commutator_position (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, (A ∘ₗ T.position - T.position ∘ₗ A) |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      ((T.a * ((n : ℕ) - (m : ℕ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ⟪|m⟩, A |n⟩⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, inner_sub_right,
    ← position_hermitian, position_apply_localizedState, position_apply_localizedState,
    map_smul, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  push_cast
  ring

modules.title: The uncertainty of a localized electron
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

An eigenvector of `H` or of `X` has no fluctuation in that observable, so its centered Gram
defect vanishes. For a localized electron `|n⟩` this means `Var X = 0`: both sides of the
energy–position uncertainty relation are `0`, and the relation says nothing about the pair.

The pair does not vanish there. As soon as the chain hops, `t ≠ 0`, and has two sites, a
localized electron fluctuates in energy, `Var H > 0`: fixing the position sends the whole
uncertainty to the energy, and only the bracket `⟨n|⁅H, X⁆|n⟩` is zero.

Conversely, a vector with positive defect is an eigenvector of neither `H` nor `X`: it
fluctuates in both.

## ii. Key results

- `flucOf_eq_zero_of_eigen` : an eigenvector has no fluctuation in its observable.
- `fluc_ne_zero_of_defectOf_pos` : a positive defect forces fluctuations in `H` and `X`.
- `flucOf_openHamiltonian_localizedState_ne_zero` : a localized electron fluctuates in energy.
- `inner_bracket_localizedState` : the bracket vanishes in a localized electron.
- `robertson_schrodinger_localizedState` : in `|n⟩`, `Var X = 0` and the defect is `0`, while
  `Var H > 0`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Eigenvectors
- B. The localized electron

## iv. References

* H. P. Robertson, *The uncertainty principle*, Phys. Rev. 34 (1929) 163.
* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.flucOf_eq_zero_of_eigen
declarations.doc: A unit eigenvector of `A` with real eigenvalue has no fluctuation in `A`.
declarations.statement:
lemma flucOf_eq_zero_of_eigen {A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace} {ψ : T.HilbertSpace}
    (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1) {c : ℝ} (h : A ψ = (c : ℂ) • ψ) : T.flucOf A ψ = 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.fluc_ne_zero_of_defectOf_pos
declarations.doc: A positive defect forces fluctuations in both `H` and `X`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fluc_ne_zero_of_defectOf_pos {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (h : 0 < T.defectOf ψ) :
    T.flucOf T.openHamiltonian ψ ≠ 0 ∧ T.flucOf T.position ψ ≠ 0

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.not_eigen_of_defectOf_pos
declarations.doc: A vector with positive defect is an eigenvector of neither `H` nor `X`.
declarations.statement:
lemma not_eigen_of_defectOf_pos {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    (h : 0 < T.defectOf ψ) (c : ℝ) :
    T.openHamiltonian ψ ≠ (c : ℂ) • ψ ∧ T.position ψ ≠ (c : ℂ) • ψ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.norm_localizedState
declarations.statement:
lemma norm_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) : ‖(|n⟩ : T.HilbertSpace)‖ = 1 :=
  (localizedState (T := T)).orthonormal.1 n

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.flucOf_position_localizedState
declarations.doc: A localized electron has no fluctuation in position.
declarations.statement:
lemma flucOf_position_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) : T.flucOf T.position |n⟩ = 0 :=
  T.flucOf_eq_zero_of_eigen (T.norm_localizedState n) (T.position_apply_localizedState n)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.exists_neighbour
declarations.doc: Every site of a chain with two sites has a neighbour.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_neighbour (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) (n : Fin T.N) :
    ∃ m : Fin T.N, (m : ℕ) + 1 = n ∨ (n : ℕ) + 1 = m

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.flucOf_openHamiltonian_localizedState_ne_zero
declarations.doc:
**A localized electron fluctuates in energy.** If the chain hops and has two sites,
`H |n⟩ - ⟨H⟩ |n⟩ ≠ 0`: its overlap with a neighbour is `-t`.
declarations.statement:
lemma flucOf_openHamiltonian_localizedState_ne_zero (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N)
    (n : Fin T.N) : T.flucOf T.openHamiltonian |n⟩ ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := T.exists_neighbour hN n
  have hmn : m ≠ n := by rintro rfl; omega
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg (fun φ => ⟪(|m⟩ : T.HilbertSpace), φ⟫_ℂ) h
  simp only [flucOf, ← Complex.coe_smul, inner_sub_right, inner_smul_right,
    T.localizedState_orthonormal_eq_ite, hmn, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero, sub_zero,
    T.inner_openHamiltonian, hm, inner_zero_right, neg_eq_zero, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero] at h'
  exact ht h'

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_bracket_localizedState
declarations.doc: The bracket `⁅H, X⁆` vanishes in a localized electron.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_bracket_localizedState (n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|n⟩, ((⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆ : Observable _) :
      _ →L[ℂ] _) |n⟩⟫_ℂ = 0 := by
  rw [inner_bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq]
  simp

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_localizedState
declarations.doc:
**Robertson–Schrödinger is empty in a localized electron.** In `|n⟩`, `Var X = 0` and the
centered Gram defect is `0`: both sides of the relation vanish. The energy does not:
`Var H > 0` as soon as the chain hops and has two sites.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_localizedState (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 2 ≤ T.N) (n : Fin T.N) :
    variance (ofVec (T.norm_localizedState n)) T.positionObservable = 0 ∧
      centeredGramDefect (ofVec (T.norm_localizedState n)) T.openHamiltonianObservable
        T.positionObservable = 0 ∧
      0 < variance (ofVec (T.norm_localizedState n)) T.openHamiltonianObservable

modules.title: Energy–position uncertainty in the open tight binding chain
modules.doc:
The energy–position uncertainty relation for the tight binding chain with open boundaries.

## i. Overview

The Hamiltonian and the position operator of the tight binding chain with open boundary
conditions are observables of the C⋆-algebra of operators on the Hilbert space of the chain.
The Robertson–Schrödinger relation then bounds their spreads in every state by the expected
bracket `⁅H, X⁆ = -(i/2) (H X - X H)`, which only sees hopping: its matrix elements are
`-(i/2) a (n - m) ⟨m|H|n⟩`.

## ii. Key results

- `toObservable` : a hermitian operator of the chain as an observable.
- `openHamiltonianObservable`, `positionObservable` : `H` and `X` as observables.
- `inner_bracket_openHamiltonian_position` : the matrix elements of `⁅H, X⁆`.
- `inner_bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq` : `⁅H, X⁆` moves exactly one site `a`.
- `robertson_schrodinger_openHamiltonian_position` : the energy–position uncertainty relation.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The Hamiltonian and position as observables
- B. The bracket of the Hamiltonian and position
- C. The uncertainty relation

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The Hamiltonian and position as observables
## B. The bracket of the Hamiltonian and position

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.toObservable
declarations.doc: A hermitian operator of the chain as an observable.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toObservable (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) (hA : A.IsSymmetric) :
    Observable (T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.openHamiltonianObservable
declarations.doc: The Hamiltonian with open boundary conditions as an observable.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev openHamiltonianObservable

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.positionObservable
declarations.doc: The position operator as an observable.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev positionObservable

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_bracket_openHamiltonian_position
declarations.doc: The bracket `⁅H, X⁆` only connects sites joined by hopping, weighted by their distance.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_bracket_openHamiltonian_position (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, ((⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆ : Observable _) :
      _ →L[ℂ] _) |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      -(Complex.I / 2) * ((T.a * ((n : ℕ) - (m : ℕ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ⟪|m⟩, T.openHamiltonian |n⟩⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [selfAdjoint.coe_bracket, smul_apply, inner_smul_right, mul_assoc,
    ← inner_commutator_position]
  rfl

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.inner_bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq
declarations.doc:
The bracket `⁅H, X⁆` moves the particle exactly one site, a distance `a`, with amplitude
`± i a t / 2`; every other matrix element vanishes.
declarations.statement:
lemma inner_bracket_openHamiltonian_position_eq (m n : Fin T.N) :
    ⟪|m⟩, ((⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆ : Observable _) :
      _ →L[ℂ] _) |n⟩⟫_ℂ =
      if (m : ℕ) + 1 = n then Complex.I * (T.a * T.t / 2 : ℝ)
      else if (n : ℕ) + 1 = m then -(Complex.I * (T.a * T.t / 2 : ℝ)) else 0 := by
  rw [inner_bracket_openHamiltonian_position, inner_openHamiltonian]
  by_cases hA : (m : ℕ) + 1 = n
  · have hn : ((n : ℕ) : ℂ) = (m : ℕ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hA.symm
    simp only [hA, Fin.ext_iff, true_or, ite_true, show (m : ℕ) ≠ n by omega, ite_false]
    push_cast [hn]
    ring
  by_cases hB : (n : ℕ) + 1 = m
  · have hm : ((m : ℕ) : ℂ) = (n : ℕ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hB.symm
    simp only [hA, hB, Fin.ext_iff, or_true, ite_true, show (m : ℕ) ≠ n by omega, ite_false]
    push_cast [hm]
    ring
  split_ifs with h <;> simp_all

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.robertson_schrodinger_openHamiltonian_position
declarations.doc:
**Energy–position uncertainty of the open tight binding chain.** In every state `ω`,
`Cov(H, X)² + ⟨⁅H, X⁆⟩² ≤ Var H · Var X`.
declarations.statement:
lemma robertson_schrodinger_openHamiltonian_position
    (ω : 𝓢[ℂ, T.HilbertSpace →L[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace]) :
    covariance ω T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable ^ 2 +
        ω⟨⁅T.openHamiltonianObservable, T.positionObservable⁆⟩ ^ 2 ≤
      variance ω T.openHamiltonianObservable * variance ω T.positionObservable

modules.title: The velocity band of forced uncertainty
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

A unit vector has minimum uncertainty when the energy–position uncertainty relation is an
equality, that is when the centered Gram defect of `H` and `X` vanishes. These vectors form a
compact set, so among them some moves fastest: the threshold `v*` is attained. Every vector
moving faster, with `v* < |⟨J⟩| ≤ maxCurrent`, carries a positive defect. This is the velocity
band `(v*, maxCurrent]`. For `N = 2, 3` the maximal current state has minimum uncertainty,
so the band is empty.

## ii. Key results

- `defectOf` : the centered Gram defect of `H` and `X` in a vector.
- `minUncertainty` : the unit vectors of minimum uncertainty, a compact set.
- `threshold` : the largest speed `|⟨J⟩|` of a vector of minimum uncertainty, attained by
  `exists_threshold`.
- `velocityBand` : the band `(threshold, maxCurrent]`.
- `defectOf_pos_of_mem_velocityBand` : in the band, the defect is forced.
- `velocityBand_eq_empty` : for `N = 2, 3` the band is empty.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Uncertainty in a vector
- B. The threshold
- C. The band

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

declarations.statement: noncomputable def defectOf (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.continuous_meanOf
declarations.statement: lemma continuous_meanOf (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) : Continuous (T.meanOf A)

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.continuous_defectOf
declarations.statement: lemma continuous_defectOf : Continuous T.defectOf

declarations.statement: lemma defectOf_nonneg (ψ : T.HilbertSpace) : 0 ≤ T.defectOf ψ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.expectation_ofVec

declarations.statement:
lemma expectation_ofVec {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (h : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    (A : T.HilbertSpace →ₗ[ℂ] T.HilbertSpace) (hA : A.IsSymmetric) :
    (ofVec h)⟨T.toObservable A hA⟩ = T.meanOf A ψ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.centeredGramDefect_ofVec_eq
declarations.doc: In a unit vector, `defectOf` is the centered Gram defect of the vector state.
declarations.statement:
lemma centeredGramDefect_ofVec_eq {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (h : ‖ψ‖ = 1) :
    centeredGramDefect (ofVec h) T.openHamiltonianObservable T.positionObservable =
      T.defectOf ψ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.minUncertainty
declarations.doc: The unit vectors of minimum uncertainty.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def minUncertainty : Set T.HilbertSpace

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.isCompact_minUncertainty
declarations.statement: lemma isCompact_minUncertainty : IsCompact T.minUncertainty

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.localizedState_mem_minUncertainty
declarations.doc: A localized electron has minimum uncertainty: its position is sharp.
declarations.statement:
lemma localizedState_mem_minUncertainty (n : Fin T.N) : (|n⟩ : T.HilbertSpace) ∈
    T.minUncertainty := by
  have hX : T.flucOf T.position |n⟩ = 0 := by
    rw [flucOf, meanOf, position_apply_localizedState, inner_smul_right,
      T.localizedState_orthonormal_eq_ite, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_re,
      ← Complex.coe_smul, sub_self]
  refine ⟨by simp [(localizedState (T := T)).orthonormal.1 n], ?_⟩
  simp [defectOf, hX]

lemma le_threshold {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hψ : ψ ∈ T.minUncertainty) :

declarations.statement: lemma threshold_le_maxCurrent (ht : T.t ≠ 0) : T.threshold ≤ T.maxCurrent

declarations.statement: noncomputable def velocityBand : Set ℝ

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.defectOf_pos_of_mem_velocityBand
declarations.doc: In the velocity band, the uncertainty defect is forced.
declarations.statement:
lemma defectOf_pos_of_mem_velocityBand {ψ : T.HilbertSpace} (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
    (hv : |T.meanOf T.current ψ| ∈ T.velocityBand) : 0 < T.defectOf ψ

declarations.doc: For `N = 2, 3` the maximal current state has minimum uncertainty: the band is empty.
declarations.statement:
lemma velocityBand_eq_empty (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : T.N = 2 ∨ T.N = 3) :
    T.velocityBand = ∅

modules.title: The velocity band is open from four sites on
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

Time reversal `Θ` (`Current/TimeReversal`) commutes with `H` and `X` and reverses the current `J`,
so it keeps the uncertainty defect, as does a global phase. A unit vector moving at the
speed limit is, up to a phase, an extreme current eigenstate, the maximal current state or its
time reverse, so it has the defect of the maximal current state. From four sites on this defect
is positive, and since the threshold is attained it lies strictly below the speed limit: the
velocity band is not empty.

## ii. Key results

- `defectOf_timeReversal`, `meanOf_current_timeReversal` : `Θ` keeps the defect and reverses
  the current.
- `defectOf_eq_of_meanOf_current_eq` : at the speed limit, the defect of the maximal current state.
- `threshold_lt_maxCurrent`, `maxCurrent_mem_velocityBand` : for `N ≥ 4` the band is not empty.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Time reversal and the uncertainty defect
- B. The speed limit is reached only by extreme eigenstates
- C. The band is not empty

## iv. References

* https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/aqm/aqmtwo.pdf. [ref: tong_statistical_physics]

sections.text: ## A. Time reversal and the uncertainty defect
## B. The speed limit is reached only by extreme eigenstates
## C. The band is not empty

declarations.name: CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.meanOf_timeReversal
CondensedMatter.TightBindingChain.meanOf_current_timeReversal

declarations.statement:
lemma maxCurrent_mem_velocityBand (ht : T.t ≠ 0) (hN : 4 ≤ T.N) :
    T.maxCurrent ∈ T.velocityBand
